feature_name: Modern Ecommerce Product Search and Bag Validation
functional_requirements: Display of product details including name, price, and sizes
business_rules: Size 40 is preferred, but fallback to first available size is mandatory if 40 is absent
Removal process must handle potential confirmation dialogs
Application must maintain state without user authentication
risks: Dynamic UI elements that may change identifiers
Product availability fluctuations impacting test stability
Pop-ups or overlay interference during interaction
validation_rules: Verify product name consistency between details page and bag
Verify size accuracy in bag vs selection
Ensure removal triggers successful empty bag state
acceptance_criteria: Successful end-to-end flow from search to bag removal
Data persistence verified in shopping bag
Verification of UI elements (header, search bar, product details)
